subject: planner: add `exprRewriterPlanCtx` and move planner related fields to it when building expression (#50065)
summary: Reviewed first-parent diff for planner changes in `pkg/planner/core/expression_rewriter.go` (+ small `planbuilder_test.go` adjustment). Change is a refactor: introduces `exprRewriterPlanCtx` to group plan/builder-scoped fields (plan, agg/window maps, insertPlan, rollExpand) and threads it through expression rewriting paths; added `intest.AssertNotNil` guards which are test-build-only (stubbed in release builds). No Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, session/privilege, concurrency, or runtime stability issues found in the touched planner logic.
